project_title: GradeWise AI - Teacher Answer Assessment Studio
theme_strategy: Warm Warm-Academic Light Mode primary with crisp high-contrast dark accents and subtle sage/clay status highlights. Tailored for prolonged teacher focus without dark-mode coldness or generic blue SaaS flatness.

typography.heading_font: Cabinet Grotesk / Outfit / Serif Accent (Playfair Display for high-level numbers & badges)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono / Fira Code (for extracted OCR text & raw scores)

scale.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900
scale.label: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600

layout_architecture.shell: Top Sticky Warm-Glass Header + Two-Column Studio Layout for Grading Workspace + Collapsible Drawer for Previous Submissions
layout_architecture.grading_workspace: Left Column (45% width): High-resolution Image/PDF viewer with zoom, page navigation, pan, and OCR highlight boxes. Right Column (55% width): Question extraction, Max Marks input, Rubric/Guidance input, AI Evaluation breakdown with edit/override capability, detailed criteria breakdown, and feedback generator.
layout_architecture.spacing_scale: Generous academic padding (p-6 to p-10 on primary panels, gap-6 on grid columns)

dashboard_hero.description: Quick dropzone hero banner with quick start presets (e.g., Math Quiz, History Essay, Short Answer) and recent grading activity.

upload_flow.step_1: Drag & Drop or File Select (JPEG, PNG, WEBP, PDF). Instant image preview with page thumbnails.
upload_flow.step_2: Configuration Bar: Set Subject, Question Text (or AI auto-extract), Maximum Marks (e.g. 10), and Optional Answer Key/Rubric.
upload_flow.step_3: Click 'Assess Answer' with live progress spinner showing OCR scanning, Rubric matching, and Feedback composition.

results_workspace.header_stats: Scored X / Max Marks with percentage pill, AI Confidence indicator, and manual override trigger.
results_workspace.side_by_side: Original document scan side-by-side with extracted student text and line-by-line mark breakdown.
results_workspace.feedback_panel: Strengths, Areas for Improvement, Suggested Marks Breakdown per criterion, and Teacher Comment box with Quick Copy or Export PDF button.

history_and_analytics.list_view: Table & Card toggle of previous student assessments, searchable by student name/id, subject, date, or mark range.
history_and_analytics.quick_actions: Re-evaluate, Export Summary, Delete record, View detailed sheet.

sample_answer_sheets.description: Answer sheet preview with test options and notes

general_ui_ux_guidelines.testing_attributes: All interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, and metric cards MUST have descriptive data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='upload-file-input', data-testid='max-marks-input', data-testid='evaluate-btn', data-testid='score-override-input').
general_ui_ux_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure contrast ratio exceeds 4.5:1 on all text labels. Focus outlines must be sharp (ring-2 ring-emerald-700 ring-offset-2). Keyboard shortcuts for quick grading navigation (e.g. Enter to confirm, Esc to close).
general_ui_ux_guidelines.empty_and_loading_states: Always show illustrative placeholder previews when no document is selected. When processing, render a realistic skeleton loader with multi-stage progress (e.g., 'Extracting handwriting...', 'Comparing against rubric...', 'Generating constructive feedback...').
general_ui_ux_guidelines.micro_interactions: Smooth transition on tab switches, score slider adjustments, and hover cards. Toast notifications using sonner for actions like 'Grade saved', 'Export generated', 'Rubric copied'.
